summary: Join our comprehensive training course on Case File Preparation and Court Presentation Skills. Equip yourself with the tools for effective legal advocacy.
lede: Case file preparation and court presentation skills help legal, investigative, and regulatory professionals organize evidence and explain a case clearly. Participants learn to plan investigations, build timelines, preserve evidence and chain-of-custody records, and assemble indexed exhibit bundles. They also practise preparing neutral case summaries and presenting evidence while responding calmly and factually to questions.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for individuals involved in preparing and presenting legal, investigative, or regulatory cases. The professionals who ensure that evidence is unassailable and presentations are compelling.
audience: Legal assistants, paralegals, and litigation support staff
Compliance, ethics, and internal investigations officers
Anti-fraud, audit, and financial investigations teams
Child protection, immigration, or social services caseworkers
modules: Documenting Facts and Building a Clear Timeline
Evidence Collection, Preservation, and Chain of Custody
Exhibit Management and File Organization Systems
Writing the Case Summary and Investigation Report
Handling Cross-Examination, Objections, and Tough Questions
Professional Conduct, Ethics, and Procedural Compliance
Digital Evidence and Technology in Case Files
Case Review, Quality Assurance, and File Readiness Check
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of legal proceedings and some experience with case preparation. Familiarity with legal documentation and evidence management is recommended but not required.
